policy.coverage_semantics: Fragrance roundup discovery targets authoritative month-level fragrance/beauty roundups from media, retailers, and official press-release outlets. Every query is searched on every monthly run; a search attempt is mandatory, but inclusion is evidence-driven and the list is not a whitelist.
policy.date_semantics: A product qualifies when an official launch, first listing, or first credible publication falls inside the target calendar month.

roundup_sources.name: NewBeauty monthly fragrance roundup
roundup_sources.query: (NewBeauty) (best new fragrances OR new fragrance OR fragrance launches) {month_name}

roundup_sources.name: Vogue Taiwan monthly fragrance roundup
roundup_sources.query: (Vogue Taiwan) (香氛新品盤點 OR 香水新品 OR 香氛新品) {year}年{month_number}月

roundup_sources.name: Scentbird monthly releases
roundup_sources.query: (Scentbird) (new perfume OR new fragrance OR releases OR subscription box) {month_name}

roundup_sources.name: T3 men's fragrance launches
roundup_sources.query: ("T3") (men's fragrance OR men's perfume OR fragrance launches) {month_name}

roundup_sources.name: Marie Claire monthly beauty products
roundup_sources.query: ("Marie Claire") (best new beauty products OR beauty launches OR new beauty products) {month_name}

roundup_sources.name: Gap Beauty relaunch
roundup_sources.query: (Gap Beauty) (fragrance relaunch OR iconic scents OR fragrance collection OR fragrance launch)

roundup_sources.name: PRNewswire fragrance press releases
roundup_sources.query: (PRNewswire OR "PR Newswire") (fragrance OR "eau de parfum" OR perfume) (launch OR debut OR enters)

evidence_grades.A: Official brand launch or product page with an exact in-window date.
evidence_grades.B: Retailer listing or reputable editorial roundup with an exact in-window publication date.
evidence_grades.C: Credible discovery or social-commerce source with an exact in-window first verified mention.
